llm_response.reason: The website features a confusing blend of lottery promotion and e-commerce elements, including unrealistic full payout claims, an uncharacteristic mix of product listings taken from known e-commerce templates, and exaggerated discounts. These aspects match several scam characteristics (e.g., handling different products from common e-commerce sites, ambiguous or dubious company claims, and overly attractive offers) that are typical of fake online shopping scams.
